test_title: RRB NTPC (UG) CBT-I Official Paper (Held On: 01 Sept, 2025 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: In which year was the National Disaster Response Force (NDRF) formed under the Disaster Management Act of 2005?
solution:
The correct answer is __**2006**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The **National Disaster Response Force (NDRF)** was formed in **2006** under the provisions of the **Disaster Management Act of 2005**.
 
• The **Disaster Management Act, 2005**, is a comprehensive law enacted by the Government of India to ensure effective management of disasters and mitigation efforts.
 
• The NDRF is a specialized force designed to respond to **natural and man-made disasters**, including earthquakes, floods, cyclones, and industrial accidents.
 
• The force operates under the authority of the **Ministry of Home Affairs**, Government of India.
 
• It is comprised of **12 battalions**, drawn from various paramilitary forces such as the **BSF, CRPF, ITBP, and CISF**.
 
• NDRF personnel are trained in **disaster response techniques**, including search and rescue operations, medical aid, and evacuation processes.
 
• The establishment of NDRF has significantly enhanced India's **disaster management capabilities** and preparedness.
 
• The force has played a pivotal role in several disaster relief operations, including the **Kashmir floods (2014), Kerala floods (2018), and Uttarakhand glacier disaster (2021)**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **2005**

 
 
• The **Disaster Management Act** was enacted in 2005 to establish disaster management authorities at the national, state, and district levels.
 
• This act provided the legal framework for forming the **National Disaster Management Authority (NDMA)** and the NDRF.
 
 
 
• **2007**
 
 
• No specific disaster management-related force or major event related to NDRF occurred in this year.
 
 
 
• **2004**
 
 
• The devastating **Indian Ocean tsunami** occurred in 2004, leading to the realization of the need for a specialized disaster response force.
 
• This event underscored the importance of establishing the NDRF, which was later formed in 2006.
